summary: Destructor-style cleanup that releases every pointer field on the object. First walks and frees a singly linked list whose head is stored at this+0x3D4: for each node it frees the payload at node+0x8, calls ShortComputation_4370 on the node, then frees the node itself, advancing via the next pointer at node+0x10. Afterwards it individually null-guards and frees the fields at this+0x3D8, this+0x3CC, this+0x20, this+0x18, this+0x10, this+0x8, and this+0x0.

operations.description: Guard: enter the list cleanup only if the head pointer at this+0x3D4 is non-null.
do-while walk over the linked list, reading the next node pointer at node+0x10 to advance and to terminate the loop when it becomes null.
Guard: the current node pointer is null-checked before being touched.
Guard: the node payload pointer at node+0x8 is freed only if non-null.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the node payload at node+0x8 to deallocate it.
Call ShortComputation_4370 on the current list node to release its internal resources.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the current list node to deallocate the node itself.
Advance the list head at this+0x3D4 to the next node (saved before the node was freed).
Guard: the pointer field at this+0x3D8 is freed only if non-null.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the pointer field at this+0x3D8.
Guard: the pointer field at this+0x3CC is freed only if non-null.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the pointer field at this+0x3CC.
Guard: the pointer field at this+0x20 is freed only if non-null.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the pointer field at this+0x20.
Guard: the pointer field at this+0x18 is freed only if non-null.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the pointer field at this+0x18.
Guard: the pointer field at this+0x10 is freed only if non-null.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the pointer field at this+0x10.
Guard: the pointer field at this+0x8 is freed only if non-null.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the pointer field at this+0x8 and carry its return value as the result.
Guard: the primary pointer field at this+0x0 is freed only if non-null.
Free the pointer field at this+0x0 and return its result, or return the earlier FreeWrapper_7bcf result when this+0x0 is null.
